openings.claim: The two volunteers may reduce shared-material omissions by assembling short runs of one pattern, consulting its existing sample at each run start, and personally counting contents before closing each envelope.
openings.delta: Keep picking, filling and checking with the volunteers, using the existing tagged shared trays and displayed samples. Change switching frequency and check timing; retain every assigned quantity and dimension. The intended benefit is complete, correctly assigned kits for participants with less correction work for volunteers; no benefit is established.
openings.prediction: With pattern mixture and tray layout matched, grouped runs with human checks will yield fewer omissions and lower combined assembly-and-check minutes per complete kit than individual mixed-pattern assembly with a final check.
openings.rival_prediction: The nearest alternative is that material access, rather than pattern switching or check timing, causes omissions. It predicts little improvement while shared-tray access stays unchanged, consistent with the loose-material small batch in O4.
openings.defeat: Matched runs that follow the proposed procedure but retain the omission rate or require equal or greater combined assembly-and-check time would defeat the predicted joint improvement.
openings.probe: Use twelve of the required kits in two six-kit lots with identical assigned-pattern mixtures: ordinary assembly plus checking, and grouped assembly plus checks before closure. Counterbalance volunteer participation; keep tray positions unchanged. Record elapsed time and audited missing items on existing tally sheets. Cap this comparison, including corrections, at twenty minutes within the overall ninety-minute session; stop it if the table boundary or time cap cannot be maintained.
assumptions: Fit evaluates the bounded probe only; completion of all sixty kits within ninety minutes with at most one distribution correction remains unproven.
Assigned pattern counts permit matched six-kit lots; this allocation is unconfirmed.
Human counting against the samples can distinguish all specified quantities and dimensions; its reliability and time cost are unverified.
O4's pattern mixture is unknown, so its zero omissions do not establish the proposed mechanism.
